title: A Machine for the Archive
author: Paloma Ashgrove
blurb: Dominic Ishikawa, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
